annotations.title: Get the current version of a product document

description: Use this when the product is known and someone wants the current PDF of one document kind: "the latest safety data sheet", "the declaration of performance", "the technical data sheet in English". Returns the current published version of one document of a product: title, kind, language, version, revision date, publication date, product page, PDF URL on ProofPass and SHA-256, plus the other languages it exists in. Never an archived version. Kinds: sdb, tdb, dop, dopc, doc, ppwr, manual, epd, cert, other, sdsus, p65, cpc, gcc (also "SDS", "TDS", "DoP", "DoC"). / Liefert die aktuelle Fassung eines Dokuments (SDB, TDB, Leistungserklärung …) mit PDF-Link. Do not use to see older versions (account: get_my_product) or to check a PDF someone already has (use verify_document).

document_language.description: ISO 639-1 language of the document, any official EU language, e.g. "de", "en", "pl", "pt", "el". Default: the language of the answer, else the manufacturer’s

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German, default), "en" (English) or "pl" (Polish). Product and account answers are written in German and English; content without a translation comes in German.

product.description: Product id from search_products, QR short code, GTIN, "manufacturer-slug/product-slug" or the product page URL

type.description: Document kind: sdb, tdb, dop, dopc, doc, ppwr, manual, epd, cert, other, sdsus, p65, cpc, gcc; "SDS"/"SDB" for the EU safety data sheet, "sdsus" for the US one (OSHA HazCom)

name: get_current_document
title: Get the current version of a product document
